title: Authenticated Reports archive path traversal to PHP include (LFI -> remote code execution)
provenance: Independent source review against the pinned vulnerable commit; the public advisory and official v30.0.01 diff are used only as ground-truth comparison, not as a claim of first discovery.
attack_chain: POST /modules/Reports/archive_manage_addProcess.php with a path outside /uploads (for example /legit_files).
POST /index.php?q=/modules/Reports/archive_manage_uploadPreview.php with a ZIP whose outer filename contains .php (spicy.php.zip) and whose entry names include PHP code plus a real student PDF.
uploadPreview writes the ZIP to archive['path'].'/temp', preserving the .php substring in the randomized filename.
GET /index.php?q=<archive path>/temp/<uploaded file> passes isAddressValid(), whose only PHP requirement is that the address contains .php; /legit_files is not blocked.
View::fetchFromFile() executes include $filepath, and the PHP code embedded in a ZIP entry name is evaluated.

source_evidence.observation: path is read directly from $_POST, only trimmed to a leading slash, then persisted by ReportArchiveGateway::insert. There is no allowlist or base-path restriction.
FileUploader::upload($tempFile['name'], $tempFile['tmp_name'], $archive['path'].'/temp') preserves the outer .php.zip filename; the resulting path is emitted as the hidden field 'file'.
The q parameter is normalized to an address, checked by Page::isAddressValid(), then passed to Page::writeFromFile().
isAddressValid requires only that the address contain .php, and blocks .., installer, uploads, config.php. It does not enforce a fixed base directory.
fetchFromFile() executes include $filepath. This is the code-execution sink.

remediation: Force archive paths under /uploads, resolve the path with realpath and reject anything outside the application root, sanitize the upload filename, and only delete/read from archive['path'].'/temp'/'<sanitized filename>'. Do not rely on isAddressValid as a directory allowlist.
ground_truth: The official v30.0.01 diff adds Validator::sanitizeFilePath and forces archive paths to /uploads in addProcess/editProcess, sanitizes filenames in uploadProcess, and restricts file operations to the archive temp directory.
